pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-07.png with Read. It loaded and I viewed it. Layout: a wide top panel, two middle panels, and a wide bottom panel.
pages.observation: How I read it: (1) Top: Meera's balloon at left, 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.', with its tail right to meera. Ravi is at right. (2) Middle left: Ravi says 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' with a tail right to ravi, then the teal label 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients' at lower left. (3) Middle right: Meera says 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' Ravi is a lone dot at the far right edge. (4) Bottom: the caption 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.', then ananya and meera at left and ravi at right. Issues: We move from Ananya's consultation on page 6 to Meera talking with Ravi, but no caption or establishing cue marks the scene change (for example, back at the front desk after the consult). Meera's 'Let's walk through what is available to you' promises a walkthrough that never comes. The page jumps to a closing caption, so the line is left hanging. In panel 3 Ravi's name label 'ravi' crosses the right panel border at about x=1000. In panel 4 the ananya and meera boxes nearly touch and ananya's label is cut off ('anany') by the meera box, so the two figures will crowd each other. Left-right placement of Meera and Ravi stays consistent across panels 1 to 3. No balloon covers a face box.
